items.headline: ComTech publishes 2026 CTRM market sizing report
items.summary: Commodity Technology Advisory released new research on the size, growth outlook and changing structure of the global CTRM/ETRM software market, per its August 18 announcement.

items.headline: Italian regulator fines A2A €5m under REMIT
items.summary: ARERA fined utility A2A €5 million for withholding gas-fired generation capacity in 2022 to push up power prices, a REMIT Article 5 economic-withholding breach; A2A plans to appeal.

items.headline: Securitisation structure targets commodity trade finance
items.summary: A new Synthesis-led trade finance securitisation aims to give institutional investors fresh access to commodity financing, as corporate trade finance securitisation activity continues rising per TXF.

items.headline: Red Sea and Black Sea shipping risks persist
items.summary: Ongoing security incidents in the Red Sea keep disrupting vessel routing, insurance costs and transit reliability, while Hapag-Lloyd has paused calls to Ukraine's Odessa region, per Adcom's freight update.
